headline: Part 3: Amend Laws to Make the Real Estate Market Transparent and Sustainably Developed
summary: The Government Inspectorate says legal transparency, data and cash flow are key requirements when amending the Land Law, Housing Law and Real Estate Business Law. The aim is to protect buyers and support sustainable market development.
why: Changes to land and real estate laws shape property rights, financing and buyer protections, which affect developers and the wider housing market investors follow.
